package domain

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"sort"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func TestPlanningSnapshotBoundIntentChangesApplicabilityReference(t *testing.T) {
	source, request := planningSnapshotFixture()
	snapshot, err := BuildStudentPlanningSnapshot(source, request)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	raw, _ := json.Marshal(snapshot)
	var body map[string]any
	json.Unmarshal(raw, &body)
	body["pending_intent"] = map[string]any{"intent_id": planningSnapshotID(50), "student_id": snapshot.StudentID, "learning_path_id": snapshot.LearningPathID, "expected_path_revision": snapshot.Path.Version, "kind": "CHANGE_GOAL", "created_at": source.CapturedAt, "requested_change": map[string]any{"scope": map[string]any{"goal_code": "go.advanced", "direction_code": snapshot.Profile.DirectionCode, "desired_stacks": snapshot.Profile.DesiredStacks}, "mutations": []any{}}}
	raw, _ = json.Marshal(body)
	var withIntent StudentPlanningSnapshot
	if json.Unmarshal(raw, &withIntent) != nil {
		t.Fatal("snapshot decode")
	}
	refs, err := snapshotReferences(withIntent)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if refs.LearnerRef == snapshot.References.LearnerRef || refs.SnapshotRef == snapshot.References.SnapshotRef {
		t.Fatal("committed learner intent does not affect coherent applicability reference")
	}
}

func TestPlanningSnapshotAbsentIntentPreservesLearnerHash(t *testing.T) {
	source, request := planningSnapshotFixture()
	snapshot, err := BuildStudentPlanningSnapshot(source, request)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	// Apply the original canonical projection normalization before hashing.
	raw, _ := json.Marshal(snapshot)
	var canonical StudentPlanningSnapshot
	json.Unmarshal(raw, &canonical)
	sort.Strings(canonical.Profile.KnownStacks)
	sort.Strings(canonical.Profile.DesiredStacks)
	sortSnapshotCollections(&canonical)
	for i := range canonical.Path.Items {
		item := &canonical.Path.Items[i]
		sortPlanningTargets(item.Targets)
		sort.Slice(item.FrozenRequirements, func(i, j int) bool { return item.FrozenRequirements[i].ID < item.FrozenRequirements[j].ID })
	}
	for i := range canonical.CourseBindings {
		sortPlanningTargets(canonical.CourseBindings[i].LearningTargets)
		canonical.CourseBindings[i].OpenedAt = time.Time{}
		canonical.CourseBindings[i].ClosedAt = nil
	}
	for i := range canonical.PracticeBindings {
		sortPlanningTargets(canonical.PracticeBindings[i].LearningTargets)
	}
	// This is the original T20.1 canonical learner reference shape.
	legacy, err := planningSnapshotDigest(struct {
		Schema, StudentID string
		Profile           PlanningSnapshotProfile
		Path              PlanningSnapshotPath
		ActivityFacts     []PlanningSnapshotActivityFact
		CourseBindings    []PlanningCourseActionBinding
		PracticeBindings  []PlanningSnapshotPracticeBinding
		Availability      PlanningSnapshotAvailability
	}{"student-learner-planning-ref.v1", snapshot.StudentID, canonical.Profile, canonical.Path, canonical.ActivityFacts, canonical.CourseBindings, canonical.PracticeBindings, canonical.Availability})
	if err != nil || legacy != snapshot.References.LearnerRef {
		t.Fatalf("absent intent changed legacy reference: %s %s %v", legacy, snapshot.References.LearnerRef, err)
	}
	raw, _ = json.Marshal(snapshot)
	var fields map[string]json.RawMessage
	json.Unmarshal(raw, &fields)
	if _, present := fields["pending_intent"]; present {
		t.Fatal("absent intent serialized")
	}
}

func TestPlanningSnapshotRejectsStaleIntentAndOwnsProjection(t *testing.T) {
	source, request := planningSnapshotFixture()
	intent := HybridLearningIntentProjection{IntentID: planningSnapshotID(50), StudentID: source.StudentID, LearningPathID: source.Path.ID, ExpectedPathRevision: source.Path.Version, Kind: "CHANGE_GOAL", CreatedAt: source.CapturedAt, RequestedChange: HybridRequestedChange{Scope: HybridScopeIdentity{GoalCode: "go.advanced", DirectionCode: source.Profile.DirectionCode, DesiredStacks: []string{"go"}}, Mutations: []HybridFutureMutation{}}}
	source.PendingIntent = &intent
	snapshot, err := BuildStudentPlanningSnapshot(source, request)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	intent.RequestedChange.Scope.DesiredStacks[0] = "changed"
	if snapshot.PendingIntent.RequestedChange.Scope.DesiredStacks[0] != "go" {
		t.Fatal("source intent aliases response")
	}
	intent.ExpectedPathRevision++
	if _, err = BuildStudentPlanningSnapshot(source, request); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("stale learner intent accepted")
	}
}
